records.plain_description: Train from verified snapshots, select a validation checkpoint, and predict future rows.

Retain earliest sufficiently improved checkpoint under absolute threshold and patience, bounded by max_epochs. Return ordered bounded query predictions, counts, selected epoch, scores and selection flag; exclude private paths/digests. Scores are selection evidence, not independent accuracy. No full-population feature materialization, portable model persistence, throughput guarantee or historical winner claim.

row.name: prepared
row.technical_description: Trusted Prepared state from the selected recipe. Revalidate configuration, descriptors, all three immutable disk snapshots, row summaries, gaps and output limit before fitting. Replay training snapshots with fresh causal history each epoch; strict-past labels only, same-time targets deferred. Eight numeric features plus fixed-width unsigned hashed categories in bounded CSR chunks. Squared-error and Huber SGD on log1p targets, equal log-score mean, nonnegative capped inverse transform. Validation labels select epochs through reusable initialize/observe providers but never update training history or estimators. Retain earliest sufficiently improved checkpoint under absolute threshold and patience, bounded by max_epochs. Return ordered bounded query predictions, counts, selected epoch, scores and selection flag; exclude private paths/digests. Scores are selection evidence, not independent accuracy. No full-population feature materialization, portable model persistence, throughput guarantee or historical winner claim.
